thread:
Rae (Growth): Quick sync, webinar + benchmark next Wed. Need final SEO checklist: keywords, Event+FAQ JSON-LD, internal link anchors for launch posts, and a redirects map for the gated report. Can we lock today?
Samir (SEO): Ill take keywords + schema. Two primaries: "inference benchmark" and "benchmark results" + four longtails. Dropping a short sheet to Drive.
Olive (Content): Internal linking plan: add 1 contextual link per launch post to /benchmark-summary, rotate anchors ("benchmark results", "benchmark findings") to avoid exact-match saturation. Also add promo CTA to docs and homepage teaser.
Jin (Infra): Preferred gated slug: /gated/benchmark-2026.pdf. Will add 301s and set X-Robots-Tag: noindex, follow on download responses.
Samir (SEO): Minimal FAQ JSON-LD for summary (paste into head): {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Whats in the benchmark?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Latency, throughput, and cost across models."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is the full report downloadable?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Full report is gated; summary is public."}}]}
Jin (Infra): Redirect examples for PR (nginx style): rewrite ^/benchmark$ /benchmark-summary permanent; rewrite ^/benchmark/pdf$ /gated/benchmark-2026.pdf permanent; rewrite ^/webinar$ /webinar/register?src=launch permanent;
Olive (Content): Canonical rules: summary -> /benchmark-summary (self-canonical). Gated PDF -> noindex, follow + X-Robots-Tag on response. OG meta should point at summary for socials.
Samir (SEO): Pagination note: keep rel=prev/next on series pages; if dupes persist canonicalize series to page 1. Also watch trailing slash normalization.
LinkBot: scheduled link-scan at 07:30 UTC tomorrow; will DM broken links.
Rae (Growth): Deliverables by EOD: Samir -> keywords + JSON-LD; Jin -> redirects CSV + smoke tests; Olive -> list of posts + anchor edits. Ill finalize CTA copy and email subject. Thanks team :rocket:
